cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
def run(obj):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","submission/main.py"],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, json.loads(p.stdout.decode()) if p.returncode==0 else p.stdout.decode()

# prefix ordering of signatures
rc,o = run({"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
  "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]})
print("prefix order:", [c["signature"] for c in o["classes"]])
print("classes:", json.dumps(o["classes"]))
print("rounds:", json.dumps(o["rounds"]))
print("summary:", json.dumps(o["summary"]))

# lost host ACK: no evidence, but proof reported
rc,o = run({"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
  "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":True,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]})
print("lost-host-ack:", json.dumps(o["rounds"]), json.dumps(o["summary"]))

# two rounds: one complete proof, one partial -> union must NOT be taken
rc,o = run({"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[3,3,3,3],
  "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
           {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
           {"u":2,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"c"}],
  "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[3],"drop_ack":[]},
            {"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":50,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[1],"drop_ack":[]}]})
